token_connection.why_this_token: Same name as the others, but launched later than the leader. It has no socials, website or DexScreener profile, and was deployed on Meteora by an unknown platform.
token_connection.competing_tokens: pwfAeX3k… (earliest, about $1.08M market cap, $167k liquidity) is the obvious canonical choice. There are also at least 6 other america.gov copies launched in the same hour (6UjoX…, BYLba…, 94pek…, GodX…, 7Jdw…, 3zT7…pump).

authenticity.evidence: GMGN counts 100 bundler wallets, and bundlers hold 69% of top-trader share. There are 1,679 unique buyers but only 87 unique sellers, which fits bot or bundle patterns.
